A′B₁ este frontul la prima atingere a su: A′B₁ is the front at first contact with the interface. During Δt, B₁ reaches B′. A₁ or A₂ is the tangency point of the secondary wavelet from A′ with the new front.
Principiul lui Huygens: fiecare punct al: Huygens’s principle: every point on a wavefront is a source of secondary wavelets. The next front is their forward envelope.
Glisează orizontal pentru a vedea întrea: Swipe horizontally to see the whole diagram.
Frontul incident AB se deplasează perpen: The incident wavefront AB travels perpendicular to itself towards the interface. A′ is the first point reached.
Punctele suprafeței devin pe rând surse: Interface points become secondary sources in succession, only when the front reaches them. Earlier sources produce wavelets with larger radii.
Noul front este înfășurătoarea undelor s: The new front is the envelope of the secondary wavelets: their common forward tangent. Tangency points are marked on the semicircles.
Frontul reflectat se îndepărtează de sup: The reflected front moves away from the interface in medium 1. Reflected rays are perpendicular to the new front.
Frontul refractat înaintează în mediul 2: The refracted front travels in medium 2 at speed v₂. Refracted rays are perpendicular to the new front.
Secțiune în planul de incidență: Section in the plane of incidence
Reflexia: unda revine în mediul din care: Reflection: the wave returns to its original medium.
Refracția: unda trece în celălalt mediu,: Refraction: the wave enters the other medium, where its propagation speed may differ.
Albastru: undă incidentă. Ocru: unde sec: Blue: incident wave. Ochre: secondary wavelets. Thick line: new front. Arrows: wave rays.
v₂ < v₁: the ray bends towards the normal.
v₂ > v₁: the ray bends away from the normal.
Equal speeds: the direction is unchanged.
De ce rezultă legea? Construcția din man: Why does the law follow? The textbook construction
A′ și B′ sunt punctele extreme ale porți: A′ and B′ are the ends of the interface segment reached. Δt is the time between the front reaching A′ and reaching B′.
Distanțele sunt egale, deoarece undele s: The distances are equal because the waves travel in the same medium at the same speed.
Împărțind relațiile membru cu membru obț: Dividing the relations gives the law of refraction. Frequency stays the same.
Unghiurile sunt măsurate față de normală: Angles are measured from the normal; rays are perpendicular to wavefronts. We draw semicircles in this section; in space, the secondary wavefronts are hemispheres. The media are homogeneous and isotropic.
